title: Aesthetics as Structural Harm: ALGORITHMIC LOOKISM ACROSS TEXT-TO-IMAGE GENERATION AND CLASSIFICATION
reasoning: The paper investigates 'lookism' (bias based on physical appearance) and its intersections with gender and race in AI models. While it addresses 'structural harm' and 'neoliberal rationality,' it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or formal systems of morals/ethics.
